title: KG-TRACES: Enhancing Large Language Models with Knowledge Graph-constrained Trajectory Reasoning and Attribution Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2506.00783v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable strides in various natural language processing tasks, but their performance on complex reasoning problems remains hindered by a lack of explainability and trustworthiness. This issue, often manifesting as hallucinations or unattributable reasoning processes, limits their applicability in complex reasoning scenarios. To address this, we propose Knowledge Graph-constrained Trajectory Reasoning Attribution and Chain Explanation Supervision (KG-TRACES), a novel framework that enhances the reasoning ability of LLMs through explicit supervision over reasoning paths and processes. translated_title: KG-TRACES：通过知识图谱约束的轨迹推理与归因监督增强大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在各种自然语言处理任务中取得了显著进展，但它们在复杂推理问题上的表现仍然受到可解释性和可信度不足的阻碍。这一问题通常表现为幻觉或无法归因的推理过程，限制了它们在复杂推理场景中的适用性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了知识图谱约束的轨迹推理归因与链式解释监督框架（KG-TRACES），这是一个通过对推理路径和推理过程进行显式监督来增强大语言模型推理能力的新型框架。KG-TRACES联合监督模型完成以下任务：（1）预测符号化关系路径，（2）预测完整的三元组级别推理路径，（3）生成基于推理路径的、具有归因意识的推理过程。在推理阶段，该模型能够自适应地应对有知识图谱和没有知识图谱的两种场景。
tldr: 提出KG-TRACES框架，通过对符号关系路径、三元组级推理路径和归因感知推理过程的显式监督，显著提升大语言模型在复杂推理任务中的可解释性和可信度。
en_tdlr: KG-TRACES enhances the explainability and trustworthiness of LLM reasoning by explicitly supervising symbolic relation paths, triple-level reasoning paths, and attribution-aware reasoning processes grounded in knowledge graphs.
